summary: BHP Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing updates to its executive leadership team. Incoming CEO Brandon Craig takes office 1 July 2026. The President Americas role is split into President North America (Jessica Farrell, effective 1 July 2026) and President South America (Farrell interim). Edgar Basto is named Chief Enterprise Performance Officer from 1 September 2026, with Geraldine Slattery assuming Copper South Australia. These are orderly succession and organizational changes, not a forced departure. The filing reflects a proactive board and management restructuring to support growth and operational focus. Watch for future earnings calls to assess execution and shareholder feedback.
